title: Arkret Agent Signer Evidence Operations
description: Server-to-server controller Account Authority gate issuance used by Agent signer evidence verification.

principal_id.description: Controller principal whose Account Authority lifecycle gate is being attested.

agent_authority_id.description: Agent PCR authority service assembling signer evidence. It MUST equal both the deployment-internal authenticated caller and service_id in the controller principal's current AcceptedAtServiceBinding.

controller_account_gate_attestation_issu.description: Closed deployment-internal request for the Account Authority-owned controller lifecycle gate. The caller identity comes from the registered internal authentication relationship, never from the request body, so no service-resolution carrier is transported. Agent state, account_id and raw account cell material are deliberately absent.
Byte-stable issuance outcome. The embedded attestation is the only Account Authority material admitted into AgentSignerEvidence.
